title: Construct exact-law catalytic copies with polynomial population rate floors
statement: Choose a positive integer circulation a_r on the fixed complex graph, D=max|y_r|, c=[(1+sum a_r)V_lambda^D]^-1. For each |w|<=K set kappa_(r,w)=c a_r/(w!lambda^y_r), a positive rational<=1 with polynomial binary length. Each fixed w copy balances because kappa lambda^(y_r+w)=c a_r lambda^w/w!, including coinciding translated complexes. w=0 retains every original edge; every enabled catalytic edge has its original enabled and same change, so directed transition graph is EXACTLY unchanged. Its total r intensity is c a_r lambda^-y_r x^falling(y_r)F_K(|x-y_r|), F_K(n)=sum_(j<=K)binom(n,j)>=c_K(1+n)^K. Thus enabled original edges have rate>=c_R V_lambda^-p0(1+|x|)^K. This preserves the nominal conditional Poisson law; reaction firings are not free.
